w: In the morning assembly Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by devotees.

National Family and Children's Shibir ( 25 to 27 June) At 6.10 pm Swamishri arrived at the University of Nottingham campus, Nottingham, for a three - day National Family Shibir (camp)and Children's Shibir.

A total of 1017 members, 674 young parents and 343 children, had registered for the shibir. The theme of the National Family Shibir was 'Aap Rijo em Raaji' and for the Children's Shibir, 'Mare Swamine Raji Karva Chhe'. The shibir agenda had been interlaced with speeches, bhajans, slide shows, Swamishri's blessings and darshan, sports and quizzes. The family shibir and children's shibir programs included: Swamishri Cares (slide show), When I needed you, You were there (incidents of kishores), Agna (speech), Divinity, Raas (folk dance), Swamishri's narration of incidents, Photo - story narration by Swamishri, Question - answer sessions and sports.

in the evening assembly volunteers of the bal mandal presented a drama 'Blind Despite Seeing' that imparted the message that parents should spare time with their children, should not over protect them and not expect more than their capacities. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly.

ph: Swamishri addresses the evening assembly on Yuva Din

w: A teachers’ convention of the ‘Rajkot District Primary Organisation’ was held in the mandir precincts. More than 2,500 primary teachers were present in the convention. At 11.40 am Swamishri blessed the convention, “The primary school teachers here have been blessed with the great service of educating children. It is like nurturing little plants. To give knowledge to children from grades one to seven is of foundational importance. You have to teach them well, inspire them with an inclination to learn and keep them away from addictions. The teachers should teach with the sentiments that the students are your children. Formerly in the ashrams of rishis students were taught self-sufficiency – doing things by themselves. Today we find the bonds of love fading between teachers and students. Science has progressed but it has brought with it many corruptive elements.”

ds.t: "Think only of God"
w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj was going towards his residence. Among the children and youths now travelling with Swamishri, Anand (Mumbai), Hetal (America) and Akshar were sitting in the poses of Gandhiji's three monkeys. Swamishri stopped there. Swamishri asked all three, "Do you know what this means?" They could not explain, so Swamishri explained the meaning: "One monkey says that what is worth seeing is God and the Sant. See them. Do not watch TV, obscene pictures and all that. In the same way the second monkey explains not to listen to worldly talk. And the third says never to speak any bad word. Sing only the praises of God." Siddharth Manjibhai, a fourth, standing with them, pressed both hands on his head and said, "And not to think bad thoughts either."
Swamishri said, "That is right. Think only of God." In this way he taught the children a lesson in good values and gave them a special memory.

ds.t: "Remove the addiction and you will be happy"
w: During some meetings after lunch, a dejected youth came to Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He said before Swamishri, "There is a whistling in my ears. Some power learns the thoughts going on in my mind through my ears and pulls those thoughts out. Because of that I keep hearing this sound."

Swamishri understood his mental state. So immediately, pointing to his own ear, Swamishri said, "I hear such a sound too. A sound comes if there is some illness. It is a defect of the ear. Otherwise no one is catching any sound. Do not fall into all these superstitions, and do bhajan: 'Swaminarayan... Swaminarayan...'"
His friend standing beside him said, "He also has an addiction."
"The sound comes because addictions have entered you. So remove them and you will be happy."

ds.t: We act as God commands
w: Bose, a veteran journalist of "Sandesh", had come for the darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He asked Swamishri a question: "You travel to bring good to the world and you do so much work. Do you still feel that even more should be done for the good of the world?"
Swamishri said, "We do not have to do anything at all. Whatever is done, God does. It is God who has to do it, and God does the work. We work according to His command."

ds.t: Because Yogi Bapa liked it
w: At 7.42 Mahant Swami Maharaj sat for breakfast. Gunkirtandas Swami sang a thal that beautifully described all the things Swamishri likes. In it, it says that Swamishri likes the values of unity, friendliness, humility as a servant and so on.
At the end Swamishri said, "One line needs to be added to this: I like all this because Yogi Bapa liked it."
The sadhus immediately added the line: "Swami likes it because Yogi Bapa likes it..."
Only one who has dissolved his own existence in his guru
can say such a thing. Where in the world can one find such an ideal disciple?

ds.t: Praying in the night
w: Today, after Mahant Swami Maharaj had gone to bed, he slept a little, or hardly at all, and woke up. He remained sitting up in bed. Shrutipriyadas Swami asked, "Swami! What happened? Are you ill? Is there some trouble?"
Swamishri said "No."
The attendants asked further, "Then what happened? Why are you sitting like this?"
"I am praying."
"For whom?"
"That it rains in India and the devotees are happy."
The attendants asked, "When do you pray?"
"Every day," said Swamishri.
This naturally brings to mind the incident when Pramukh Swami Maharaj woke at 2.30 at night in London and did a dhun for rain.
One more instance of the likeness of the gurus came to light.

ds.t: Written answers at the youth shibir
w: Today Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the youth shibir. A question and answer programme had been arranged here. The plan was that the teenagers would present their questions one by one and Swamishri would answer them in writing.

The first question was asked: "We are not able to come to the assembly every Sunday, and the reasons seem reasonable too. For one thing, the mandir is far from home, we have to look after our jobs, little muktas (children) have arrived at home, and we also feel bored, so the question naturally arises: what is the benefit of the assembly and discussions?"
Swamishri wrote: "Faith does not overcome your desires." That is, your faith has not yet become strong enough to subdue your desires.

The second question was asked: "The days are short, we do not get time for ahnik (daily worship), thoughts come like 'we will do it later,' but later never comes. And when we do it, it is not done with the mind. We do it just for the sake of doing it, and the question arises: what is the benefit of doing ahnik? How can we become completely absorbed in ahnik?"
Swamishri wrote: "You are perfectly right. But suppose Shriji Maharaj and the Gunatit Gurus were to deal with you personally, then of course the ahnik would definitely change."
Swamishri explained that if ahnik is done with the feeling that they are directly present, it will improve one hundred percent.

After that it was asked: "When we start our careers, because of the environment we are unable to keep niyam and dharma. In such circumstances, what should we do so that we do not slacken in niyam and dharma, and while keeping them, also succeed in social life and at work?"
Swamishri wrote: "One is to please Bhagwan and the sadhu. The other is to please others. Which is better and much more fruitful? The answer is in it."
Everyone welcomed Swamishri's piercing answers.
Then Swamishri was requested, "You are a good artist, so please draw a picture for us."
Swamishri drew a beautiful face of Nilkanth Varni and wrote beneath it: "Love for Nilkanth Varni."

ds.t: Jump at it
w: In the evening, showering blessings in the main assembly of Kishore Day, Mahant Swami Maharaj said, "Maharaj said: even if he does not serve us, if he sings the praises of devotees, we consider that he has done us the greatest seva."
As if he were leading a workshop, Swamishri went on, "Is this true?"
Everyone said "Yes" together.
"Really?" Again everyone said "Yes."

"Then jump at it! Why do a loss making business! Shriji Maharaj says this. There is no authority above him. If you do not have faith in what he says, what have you achieved? Have faith in his words and take only the positive. Do your best, leave the rest."

ds.t: We will surely take you
w: A presentation was made before Mahant Swami Maharaj: "Just as Pramukh Swami Maharaj held your hand, he has also held our hands and placed them in your hands."
Swamishri made a gesture as if offering everyone's hands to Harikrishna Maharaj.
Blessing the youths, who had joined hands with one another and committed themselves to unity, Swamishri said, "We have come to take you to Akshardham, and we will surely take you."
Swamishri gave the promise of Akshardham in such clear words!!
